officialCard.heading: High-Energy Astrophysics Laboratory
officialCard.localizedFullText: High-Energy Astrophysics Laboratory UC San Diego has a long-history of designing X-ray satellites and Gamma-ray instrumentation. Today, active balloon-borne gamma-ray satellites are being designed and built at UCSD with detector testing and instrument development. Gamma-ray programs are active in Compton Spectrometer and Imager (COSI) , GAP experiment, and NuStar. PI: Professor Steve Boggs
